## Description

If the transcript mentions a different patient name than the bound encounter, or the doctor reports a mix-up, show "Different name heard … Encounter is bound to {name}" with Stop & lock / It is correct. Stop & lock freezes the session; re-binding a recording to another patient requires a reason, creates a new encounter and consent check, and is audited.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Stop & lock prevents further capture and drafting for that session.
- [ ] **AC2.** Re-binding requires a reason and a new consent for the correct encounter; both are audited.
- [ ] **AC3.** A recording can never be attached to two active encounters (constraint test).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
